summary: Idaho lookout on the Caribou-Targhee National Forest: 1922 pole platform tower, 1934 frame cabin, destroyed 1966. Register photos from 2021 show footings and debris remaining.

facts.design: Pole platform tower (1922), then frame cabin (1934)
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1966. The register says wood footings and concrete debris remain at the site.

staffing.status: A 1937 Post-Register item, quoted on Forest Lookouts Idaho, names Herman Blazer in charge. Idaho Fire Lookouts documents no staffing history.

access.note: Drive-up per Idaho Fire Lookouts, on Caribou-Targhee National Forest land. No source describes a closure or permit requirement.

visit.trail_note: No tower stands. Only footings and debris remain, per the register.

events.note: Pole platform tower with a small observation cabin and a residence ground cabin.
Frame cabin replaced the original structure.
Herman Blazer placed in charge, per a Post-Register item quoted on the Forest Lookouts Idaho page.
Same item says a new lookout station was established on Highpoint. This conflicts with the 1922 build date; the sources do not reconcile it.
Item reports two fires extinguished in the previous week, one near Hatchery Butte. It does not say which station spotted them.
Registered August 12, 2021; nominated by Brad Eells.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register spells the forest Caribou-Targee in both its location and administrator lines. firelookout.com spells it Caribou-Targhee, and Idaho Fire Lookouts spells it Carabou-Targhee (a typo for Caribou). Spelling only; the Forest Service administers the site under either name.
Register gives 7,248 ft (2,209 m). Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 7,281 ft. The record uses the register figure.
Idaho Fire Lookouts says no staffing history is documented. The Forest Lookouts Idaho page quotes a 1937 item naming Herman Blazer in charge.
Register and other sites date the first structure to 1922. The 1937 item says a new lookout station was established on Highpoint. The sources do not reconcile the two.

notes_for_editor: Construction (1922 tower, 1934 frame cabin) and 1966 destruction agree across the register, firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts. Open issues: the 1937 Post-Register item (quoted on Forest Lookouts Idaho) says a new station was established, which does not fit the 1922 date; staffing rests on that single 1937 item. Elevation differs by 33 ft between the register and the other two sites. The 2021 register photos are not added to photos because no image URLs were extracted. Forest name spelled Caribou-Targee on the register, Caribou-Targhee on firelookout.com and Carabou-Targhee (typo) on Idaho Fire Lookouts; the record's current spelling follows the register, so no correction proposed. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the story's Idaho Fire Lookouts spelling claim was corrected to the Targhee spelling; the 1937 item's date, station and fire details match the Forest Lookouts page, which does not say which station spotted the fires; the footings credit to Samsara Duffey matches the register.
